headline: Houthi strike damages skyscraper housing Saudi Sovereign Wealth Fund
summary: A Riyadh skyscraper housing the headquarters of Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund sustained damage from a new missile strike launched by Yemen's Houthis.
why: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund manages over $900 billion in global assets and domestic development projects.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Attacks targeting Saudi infrastructure elevate geopolitical security risk premiums.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Direct strikes against infrastructure in Riyadh increased geopolitical risk premiums in Middle East energy markets.
